Portuguese

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /isˈt͡ʃĩ.mɐ/, /esˈt͡ʃĩ.mɐ/
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /isˈt͡ʃĩ.mɐ/, /esˈt͡ʃĩ.mɐ/
    • (Rio de Janeiro) IPA(key): /iʃˈt͡ʃĩ.mɐ/, /eʃˈt͡ʃĩ.mɐ/
    • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /esˈt͡ʃi.ma/
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /(i)ʃˈti.mɐ/

  • Hyphenation: es‧ti‧ma

Etymology 1

[edit]

Deverbal from estimar.

Noun

[edit]

estima f (plural estimas)

  1. esteem, or respect
  2. affection

estima

    Tagalog

    [edit]

    Alternative forms

    [edit]
    • istima

    Etymology

    [edit]

    Borrowed from Spanish estimar.

    Pronunciation

    [edit]
    • (Standard Tagalog) IPA(key): /ʔestiˈma/ [ʔɛs.t̪ɪˈma]
    • Rhymes: -a
    • Syllabification: es‧ti‧ma

    Noun

    [edit]

    estimá (Baybayin spelling ᜁᜐ᜔ᜆᜒᜋ)

    1. esteem; regard
      Synonyms: pagpapahalaga, paggalang
    2. act of entertaining or attending to visitors
